Class AbstractScanBuilder<T, S extends AbstractScanBuilder<T,S>>

java.lang.Object
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.builder.base.AbstractScanBuilder<T,S>
Type Parameters:
T - the item type
S - the concrete builder type (for fluent chaining)
Direct Known Subclasses:
AsyncScanBuilder, ScanBuilder
public abstract class AbstractScanBuilder<T, S extends AbstractScanBuilder<T,S>> extends Object
Abstract base for sync and async scan builders.

    • filter

      public @NonNull S filter(@NonNull Map<String,Object> conditions)
      Configures a scan filter from a map of attribute-value pairs.

      All conditions are combined with AND. Each entry is treated as an equality filter. For other condition types, use filter(Consumer).

      Parameters:
      conditions - a map of attribute names to their expected values
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining
